description: This file defines the TaxwareException class, a custom exception used within the org.apache.ofbiz.order.thirdparty.taxware package, extending the GeneralException class. It provides constructors for creating exception instances with or without message strings and nested throwables.

classes.name: TaxwareException
classes.description: A custom exception class for handling errors specific to the Taxware integration in the order module, extending the GeneralException class from the OFBiz framework.
